items.title: FOMO Trading: How to Recognize It and Stop It With Data (2026)
items.extracted_insight: Widening stops. You enter a trade and it goes slightly against you. Your stop says to exit at -1%. Instead, you move the stop wider because you "know" it's going to reverse. What you're actually doing is refusing to accept that the trade might be wrong. This single behavior destroys your risk-reward ratio and makes even winning trades unprofitable
